title: "W07_task2"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
sales_raw <- read_csv("https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/sales.csv")
View(sales_raw)
```

```{r}
sales <- sales_raw %>%
  mutate(time_utc = ymd_hms(Time, tz = "UTC"),
    time_local = with_tz(time_utc, tzone = "America/Denver"),
    month = floor_date(time_local, "month"),
    hour = hour(time_local)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Name), !is.na(time_local), !is.na(Amount), Amount > 0)

View(sales)
```

```{r}
monthly_revenue <- sales %>%
  group_by(Name, month) %>%
  summarize(gross_revenue = sum(Amount), .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_revenue
```

```{r}
ggplot(monthly_revenue, aes(x = month, y = gross_revenue, color = Name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Gross Revenue by Company", x = "Month", y = "Gross revenue", color = "Company") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
monthly_traffic <- sales %>%
  group_by(Name, month) %>%
  summarize(transactions = n(), .groups = "drop")

monthly_traffic
```

```{r}
ggplot(monthly_traffic, aes(x = month, y = transactions, color = Name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Monthly Customer Traffic by Company", x = "Month", y = "Number of transactions", color = "Company") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
hourly_operations <- sales %>%
  group_by(Name, hour) %>%
  summarize(transactions = n(), .groups = "drop")

hourly_operations
```

```{r}
ggplot(hourly_operations, aes(x = hour, y = transactions, fill = Name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Transactions by Hour of Day", x = "Hour of day", y = "Number of transactions", fill = "Company") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
company_summary <- sales %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarize(total_revenue = sum(Amount), total_transactions = n(), average_transaction = mean(Amount), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_revenue))

company_summary
```

Based on the graphs and table, I would choose HotDiggity as the best-performing company. HotDiggity had the highest total revenue at $22,574.68 and also had the most transactions with 5,811. Even though companies like LeBelle and SplashandDash had higher average transaction amounts, HotDiggity brought in the most money overall because it had a lot more sales. So, I think HotDiggity performed the best over the three months.
